purpose: Development-only comparison of the previously selected conservative multi-rate envelope and a separately implemented bounded AgACI-style weighted guard. This protocol was designed after the completed JPL October transfer study, so that result remains locked and is not read, rerun, or used for candidate selection. JPL May is used only for development; JPL June and December raw files remain unacquired until their later protocol stages.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At each plug-in each guard uses only JPL April calibration scores and JPL physical unplug outcomes already observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: Run both predeclared candidates on May. Select only among candidates reaching 90% empirical coverage; then maximize coverage, P10 service, Jain index, energy service, and finally minimize mean guard buffer. Record the decision before acquiring June or December raw data.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Development evidence only. The bounded AgACI-style mode has online expert weights but no transferred finite-sample, per-driver, conditional, or universal coverage guarantee.

agaci_weighted.reference: Zaffran et al. (ICML 2022) AgACI; Gibbs and Candès (JMLR 2024) online learning-rate adaptation. The FairFlex implementation maps the published weighting update to delayed one-sided EV-unplug scores and clips alpha to the documented finite-score-bank bounds.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real JPL sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Fixed regional GHI resource proxy; it is not measured JPL rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for a controlled sensitivity experiment; it is not measured JPL PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Deliberately severe synthetic shared feeder-import budget; it is not a measured JPL feeder limit.
